The '''SoroSuub District''' was a district in [[Geharr]], [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] operated a number of factories in the district, which it used to produce [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components. The company also operated a [[SoroSuub Geharr headquarters tower|headquarters tower]] in the district.<ref name="Strongholds" />
